safeInspection.reproduceRecursiveAudit:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
from zipfile import ZipFile
from io import BytesIO
import stat
root = Path('/home/runner/work/Folio_Commissioned/Folio_Commissioned')
def audit(z):
    for i in z.infolist():
        n = i.filename.replace('\\', '/')
        assert not (PurePosixPath(n).is_absolute() or '..' in PurePosixPath(n).parts or (len(n) > 1 and n[1] == ':') or stat.S_ISLNK(i.external_attr >> 16)), n
        if n.lower().endswith('.zip'):
            with ZipFile(BytesIO(z.read(i))) as child:
                audit(child)
for p in sorted(root.glob('*.zip')):
    with ZipFile(p) as z:
        audit(z)
    print(p.name, 'PASS')
PY

sourceDecision.basis: The selected module is byte-identical across both source packages. Suite and Workspace version schemes are not assumed comparable, and ZIP timestamps are not release authority. The newer Rationalisation_pack is a separate UI planning/configuration overlay and is not required for this transport fix.
sourceDecision.delivery: Single-file source overlay, not a standalone runnable application. Its imports intentionally retain packaged paths. To evaluate the complete app, safely extract the supplementary suite to a disposable directory and overlay this module at runtime/core/data-client.js. Do not serve this repository root: it contains archives and reports.
sourceDecision.deploymentGate: No automatic archive repacking or deployment. A maintainer must integrate this overlay into the authoritative full source/build pipeline, regenerate and verify package integrity manifests, and approve a release. Copying this file into an old package invalidates that package's recorded digest.

observations: Compose_Dynamic_Input reads fields such as operation, entityType, title and entityKey directly under triggerBody().payload, falling back to the request root; it does not read these from payload.data.
Compose_Dynamic_Gate and Switch_Dynamic_Gate contain unauthenticated, forbidden, invalid, replay and ok paths. Their result Compose nodes include status 401, 403 and 400 with data.code/data.message.
The packaged client already refuses ordinary JSON HTTP 4xx responses except 408 and 429. The demonstrated gap is malformed/non-JSON error bodies losing HTTP status before refusal classification.
The older report's 14/15 rejection result was a historical simulator result, not a new measurement. No current tenant endpoint, role, persistence or operation compatibility was verified.
